activity.notes: Pius IX returned to Rome under restored papal temporal government in 1850 and remained sovereign of the surviving Papal States until Italian forces captured Rome and temporal power ended in September 1870. This is intentionally separate from the first phase because the Roman Republic created a genuine interruption in effective territorial rule; his pontificate continued to 1878.

sources.title: Pius IX — Holy See
sources.citation_text: The Holy See gives Pius IX's pontificate as 1846-1878.

sources.title: Blessed Pius IX — Holy See
sources.citation_text: The Holy See notes the fall of Rome and temporal power on 20 September 1870.

sources.title: Pius IX — Treccani, Dizionario di Storia
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Pius IX's flight from Rome, proclamation of the Roman Republic in 1849, return to Rome in 1850 after the republic's defeat, and the final Italian occupation of Rome in 1870.
